attempts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production-layout transparent sprite ATLAS, not a presentation sheet. Input is a binding 1024x1024 placement guide. Preserve the square canvas and all nine occupied regions EXACTLY, including the extremely large transparent gaps. Three columns and three rows. Do not centre or enlarge any individual vignette, do not normalize all vignettes to equal size, do not redistribute the grid. Match the occupied pixel bounds and ground positions of every guide group. The small groups in the top row MUST stay small; do not render high detail and shrink it. Top row is distant map rendering with silhouette and 1–2 broad marks only; middle row medium map rendering with a few broad facade bands; bottom row near map rendering, still loose and simple. Same compound repeated at different actual sizes down each column. Column 1 exactly three compact taller modern cream gray-blue apartment towers and one long moderately tall slab. Column 2 exactly three compact tall towers, one long upper-left modern slab, one diagonal shorter slab lower-left and one diagonal shorter slab upper-right; these slabs are relatively modern and about 60% tower height. Column 3 exactly the nine red-brick roof segments in the guide, long and bent old Soviet-style red-brick walkup forms with gray simple roofs; no new tower or invented separate house. No literal brick grid. All outlines, directions, spaces, width/height and silhouettes remain tied to the guide. STYLE: warm casual fountain pen, broad wobbly simple strokes, muted watercolor with paper grain inside pigment. Far row stroke roughly 1.3px, middle 1.5px, near 1.8px at reference size. No elaborate roof equipment, no fine window grids. BUILDINGS ONLY. All spaces between and around buildings completely transparent, NO yard wash, ground patch, trees, bushes, background paper, shadow, halo, people, vehicles, words, numbers, divider lines, labels or border. Keep exterior wall and roof edges reasonably crisp; warmth comes from pigment inside, never fuzzy fading of a building wall. This atlas will be cropped into nine parts and composited over an independently drawn ground, so clean alpha, exact nine group placement and the different native sizes are critical.
attempts.result: seven size gates pass, two return; fine window details remain
